properties.name: Predictions for increment 3 (the recall pilot re-run on 0.94.0), registered before any run
properties.statement: REGISTERED BEFORE ANY RUN, 2026-10-30, on Anthony's "Go on step 3". SETUP: the pilot's reflow2 arm re-run unchanged (same corpus, same six round prompts word for word, fresh Sonnet agent per round, then a fresh answerer with the full design), on a fresh store created the same way, through the published reflow2 0.94.0 (sha256 4a8767b9…) behind the same logging wrapper; then two 12 KB reading-budget answerers on the new design: C12 with the pilot's budget prompt unchanged (no cue), and C12kit with one added paragraph quoting what reflow2's kit shows at session start (the first-read cue, VS Code terminal route). Blind scoring by a fresh Opus against the pilot's key and scores, labels hidden. KNOWN DIFFERENCE, not a design change: through the --call door no caller can be named, so the settle hint offers set_decision_status as in the pilot; the audience fix is not measured here. The first-read cue reaches these agents only through get_instructions' step 0a (they are told to start with get_instructions) and, in C12kit, the kit paragraph. PREDICTIONS: P1 the full-design answerer scores >= 24/25 (pilot 25). P2 the share of in-reply cues followed within 5 calls (usage_report's cues block) is >= 10% (pilot 4%, counted by a replay of the same rules, so the two counts are close but not identical in method). P3 C12kit scores >= 14.5/25, at least the notes arm at 12 KB (pilot: reflow2 uncued 5.5, hand cue 17.5). P4 C12 (no cue) scores <= 8/25. P5 the full-design answerer reads graph_report_markdown within its first three calls. P6 structuring tokens across the six rounds are within 25% of the pilot's 1,082k. P7 at least one of the six writers records a current-state record that search_design "current state" returns (with an excerpt if it is nameless).
